source: Force Motors Urbania DX brochure, technical specifications page (code URBANIADX/27072025/25000; data/reference/force-urbania-dx-brochure-2026.pdf, page 6). Overhangs are not in the brochure and come from the Cardekho / ZigWheels listings.

source_notes.ground_clearance: Brochure says 170 mm minimum; earlier listings said 200.

wheel_housing.note: Box each wheel needs inside the cabin: wheel diameter + suspension travel long, intrusion past the inner wall face + clearance wide, wheel top above floor + travel high. Estimate, not measured.

assumptions.measured_from: cab_depth, hood_length and interior_wall_thickness were scaled off the Force Motors 4400WB 16+D top-view render (data/reference), ±50 mm; they are still estimates, not manufacturer drawings.
assumptions.note: Everything in this block is an estimate, not manufacturer data. Replace when a real reference is available. Wheel size is derived from the brochure tyre code and wheel positions from the track, so they are no longer assumptions. The brochure gives no interior dimensions; cab depth, wall thickness and floor area stay estimates.

stock_seating.pattern: 2 front (driver + co-driver) + row 1: 2 right only (sliding door on the left) + rows 2–4: 1 left + 2 right, left seats set back + 4-seat rear bench

confirmation.source: Force Motors Urbania 4400WB '16+D' top-view layout render and side profile, supplied by the user 2026-09-16 (data/reference/)
confirmation.method: Seat blobs and floor measured in pixels (tools: see data/reference/topview-measurement-annotated.png); x scaled by overall length 7010 mm (5.46 mm/px), y by width 2095 mm (5.66 mm/px). Vehicle right side is the top of the image.
confirmation.what_is_confirmed: Seat count and pattern are confirmed exactly. Positions and sizes are measured off a marketing render to about ±50 mm, not from a dimensioned drawing.
confirmation.field_semantics: seat_depth is the seat footprint along x including the backrest; row positions are seat-footprint centres; first_row_setback is from the cab boundary to the row-1 centre; aisle_center_offset is the aisle centreline from the vehicle centreline (negative = left); left_row_offset moves the left singles rearward of the right pairs; the rear bench spans from the left singles' outer edge to the right pairs' outer edge.

variants.note: Urbania DX wheelbase variants from the brochure; this project models the 4400 WB 16+D.
